temporal_state_chain.observed: Cheryl looks stressed and overwhelmed by the stacks of paperwork and planning for the new community outreach project; when Maria offers help, Cheryl gratefully accepts.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria had no specific belief that Cheryl was struggling; she saw Cheryl as responsible for the outreach project and had not yet assessed her workload.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Maria learns that Cheryl is overwhelmed and open to receiving assistance.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Cheryl needs and welcomes help with the project, and Maria is able to provide useful support.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concern and compassion, followed by willingness and helpfulness.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Help Cheryl with the paperwork and planning for the community outreach project.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After Maria has helped Cheryl, Maria sees Cheryl handling responsibilities better and gaining confidence; in the staff meeting, Maria suggests Cheryl for leadership, and Cheryl accepts the challenge while thanking Maria.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria believes Cheryl has improved in handling responsibilities and is growing more confident.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Maria's belief is confirmed and strengthened when Cheryl accepts the leadership role and appreciates Maria's confidence.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Cheryl is capable, ready, and willing to lead the next phase of the project.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Support Cheryl in taking on the leadership role and see the project move forward under her leadership.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria approaches Cheryl privately and asks whether she felt supported rather than pressured; Cheryl says she was surprised but appreciates Maria's support and belief in her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria worries that Cheryl might perceive the leadership suggestion as overstepping or pressure.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Maria's worry is reduced when Cheryl says she was surprised but appreciative and not pressured.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Cheryl values Maria's honesty and support, and there are no hard feelings about the leadership suggestion.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Initial worry or anxiety, followed by relief and reassurance.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Ensure Cheryl feels supported, clarify Maria's intentions, and maintain trust in their relationship.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria feels relieved that Cheryl valued her honesty and support; Maria proposes co-leading the project, and Cheryl enthusiastically agrees, calling Maria's guidance invaluable and saying they make a great team.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria believes Cheryl appreciates her support and that they can continue collaborating positively.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Cheryl's enthusiastic agreement confirms that co-leading is mutually desired and that Cheryl welcomes Maria's guidance.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Maria and Cheryl can effectively co-lead the project and support each other as a team.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Co-lead the project with Cheryl and continue supporting each other.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria and Cheryl have successfully collaborated on several projects and strengthened their partnership; Maria discusses future projects, and Cheryl says she would love to team up again and is excited about what they can achieve together.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria believes their collaboration has been fruitful and their partnership is strong and synergistic.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Cheryl's eager response confirms and deepens Maria's belief that their partnership is mutually valued and sustainable.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Maria and Cheryl have a strong, successful partnership and are both excited to work together on future projects.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Team up with Cheryl for more projects in the future.
